projects.name: Ocean Swell
projects.engine: Three.js 3D + analytic-wave PlaneGeometry + domain-warped fbm + anisotropic sun glitter
projects.description: A real 3D ocean-swell surface: analytic vertex-shader travelling waves with exact per-vertex normals/tangents drive both the wave-fold geometry and a Kajiya-Kay anisotropic 'sun glitter' specular that scatters into scintillating points (via a sparkle threshold mask) instead of a continuous streak. Diffuse color stays fully isotropic domain-warped fbm so it reads as drifting current bands, not wood grain. Whitecap foam appears at wave crests and steep faces, and sun hue/tint plus glitter blend mode (Add/Screen/Overlay) are fully adjustable.

projects.name: Edge Radiant Honeycomb Matrix
projects.engine: p5.js CPU attractor-driven honeycomb square matrix
projects.description: Converts the input into a honeycomb square matrix with darkness-sorted attractor dynamics. Image1 is generated as edge-find with outward radiation, then remapped by its own min/max to 0-1 brightness. Squares sample color directly from the original input, while darker Image1 cells (processed from darkest to brightest) attract brighter cells proportionally to distance; attraction only affects brighter neighbors and includes non-overlap relaxation with adjustable strength.
controls: Edge Sample / Edge Threshold / Edge Soft / Radiant Radius / Edge Gain
Attract Amp / Influence Radius / No Overlap / Relax Passes
